model.spacecraft: representative 1U CubeSat with active impedance docking arm
model.contact_model: MuJoCo mesh + multi-geom contact; dock_capture weld armed after tip capture; per-contact forces from mjData-synced forward pass
model.arm_structure: 4-link articulated arm on Hub 2 with stable spring-damper control
model.note: Reaction forces are recorded for analysis but are not copied back into the Python control loop.

environment.gravity_model: Earth spherical harmonics (J2/degree-2) + Moon/Sun point masses via NBodyGravity

control_summary.note: The controller holds a zero-angle equilibrium; XML joint damping provides passive contact compliance.
